first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: passageway floor
entities.identification: A continuous expanse of gray hard flooring inside the passageway, affected by purple illumination, with a yellow boundary line and elongated reflections in some areas.

entities.name: passageway wall
entities.identification: The light-colored walls and dark lower wall bands on both sides of the passageway, with protruding wall corners and rectangular doorways along the route.

entities.name: passageway ceiling
entities.identification: The relatively dark overhead area above the passageway, containing transverse and longitudinal structural elements and some light-colored bright surfaces.

entities.name: purple-orange passageway light fixture
entities.identification: A collection of lights near the passageway side walls and ceiling, with visible purple-pink strip-shaped illuminated sections and localized orange-yellow brightly lit areas.

entities.name: illuminated direction marker
entities.identification: Wall arrows and illuminated angled shapes on the ceiling arranged along the passageway, as well as cyan-blue illuminated shapes on the floor that appear in some frames.
